A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ACE research and contain 23 readable pages, including Appendices A–D. Pages 2–23 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance; the first-page changes are directly comparable.

before.justification: v1 reports original ACE experiments on AppWorld, FiNER, and Formula in Tables 1–2, with ablation and efficiency results in Tables 3–4.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark, ablation, and efficiency results in Tables 1–4. Their retention from v1 does not change their empirical status.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix D retain the same Generator–Reflector–Curator procedure, incremental delta updates, grow-and-refine mechanism, and prompts. No method component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate AppWorld's normal and challenge tasks, FiNER financial entity recognition, and Formula numerical reasoning. No dataset, task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: Table 1 retains ReAct, ICL, GEPA, and DC (CU); Table 2 retains Base LLM, ICL, MIPROv2, GEPA, and DC (CU). The Appendix C leaderboard snapshot is also identical.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 retain the same splits, offline pass@1 and sequential online protocols, metrics, supervision settings, DeepSeek-V3.1 configuration, batch size, and adaptation budgets.

E4.justification: The context-collapse case study in Figure 2, Reflector/multi-epoch/offline-warmup ablations in Table 3, and efficiency analysis in Table 4 are unchanged. No additional robustness or supplementary analysis appears.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting. Neither reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests.

E6.justification: All result entries and findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1's online ACE average remains 59.5%, while Table 2's supervised offline ACE accuracies remain 78.3% on FiNER and 85.5% on Formula.

T1.justification: Neither version introduces formal theoretical results or proofs. The definitions and methodological reasoning in Sections 2–3 are identical, with no mathematical additions or corrections.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the same contributions and claims about evolving playbooks, preventing context collapse, benchmark performance, adaptation without labels, leaderboard competitiveness, and reduced adaptation overhead.

C2.justification: The interpretations in Sections 4–5 and limitations in Appendix B are identical, including dependence on reliable feedback and a capable Reflector, and limited benefits for tasks needing only concise guidance.

D1.justification: v2 adds explicit ACE GitHub repository and project-website links on page 1, absent from v1. This adds resource-access information; implementation settings and Appendix D prompts remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish the linked resources' contents.

R1.justification: The references and related-work discussions, including Appendix A, are identical. Attribution to Dynamic Cheatsheet and positioning relative to prompt optimization and agent-memory research remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 updates correspondence addresses, adds another contact and resource links, and adds an ICLR 2026 acceptance note on page 1. The scientific prose, terminology, section order, and appendices are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added link row and acceptance footnote slightly adjust first-page spacing and the placement of Figure 1 and introductory text. Figure content and table structures are unchanged; pages 2–23 are visually identical.

improvement.justification: The new repository and project-page pointers provide a useful, limited improvement in resource-access documentation. Scientific content, empirical evidence, and appendices remain unchanged. The improvement concerns discoverability; the PDFs alone do not establish the linked code's completeness or reproducibility.
